// ============= HELPER FUNCTIONS =============

/**
 * Converts a local datetime string from HTML datetime-local input
 * to an ISO 8601 string with timezone offset
 * @param localDateTime - DateTime string from datetime-local input (e.g., "2024-01-15T14:30")
 * @param timezone - IANA timezone string (e.g., "America/New_York")
 * @returns ISO 8601 datetime string with timezone offset (e.g., "2024-01-15T14:30:00-05:00")
 */
function convertLocalDateTimeToTimezone(
  localDateTime: string,
  timezone: string,
): string {
  if (!localDateTime) {
    return "";
  }

  try {
    // Parse the local datetime string
    const [datePart, timePart] = localDateTime.split("T");
    if (!datePart || !timePart) {
      throw new Error("Invalid datetime format");
    }

    // Add seconds if not present
    const timeWithSeconds = timePart.length === 5 ? `${timePart}:00` : timePart;

    // Parse date components
    const dateParts = datePart.split("-").map(Number);
    const timeParts = timeWithSeconds.split(":").map(Number);

    if (dateParts.length < 3 || timeParts.length < 2) {
      throw new Error("Invalid date or time components");
    }

    const [year, month, day] = dateParts as [number, number, number];
    const [hours, minutes, seconds = 0] = timeParts as [
      number,
      number,
      number?,
    ];

    // Create a date object for the exact local time
    // Then format it with the target timezone to get the offset
    const localDate = new Date(
      year,
      month - 1,
      day,
      hours,
      minutes,
      seconds || 0,
    );

    // Use a formatter to extract the timezone offset
    // We format the same moment in time to get the offset
    const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
      timeZone: timezone,
      year: "numeric",
      month: "2-digit",
      day: "2-digit",
      hour: "2-digit",
      minute: "2-digit",
      second: "2-digit",
      timeZoneName: "longOffset", // This gives us the offset like "GMT-05:00"
      hour12: false,
    });

    const formattedParts = formatter.formatToParts(localDate);
    const timeZoneName =
      formattedParts.find((part) => part.type === "timeZoneName")?.value || "";

    // Extract offset from the timezone name (e.g., "GMT-05:00" -> "-05:00")
    let offset = "Z"; // Default to UTC
    if (timeZoneName.includes("GMT")) {
      const match = /GMT([+-]\d{2}:\d{2})/.exec(timeZoneName);
      if (match?.[1]) {
        offset = match[1];
      } else if (timeZoneName === "GMT") {
        offset = "Z";
      }
    }

    // Return the ISO 8601 format with the extracted offset
    return `${datePart}T${timeWithSeconds}${offset}`;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error converting datetime to ISO 8601:", error);
    // Fallback: return with UTC indicator
    const hasSeconds = localDateTime.split(":").length >= 3;
    return hasSeconds ? `${localDateTime}Z` : `${localDateTime}:00Z`;
  }
}

async function getOrganizationWithResources(organizationId: string) {
  const organization = await db.organization.findUnique({
    where: { id: organizationId },
    select: {
      id: true,
      agentName: true,
      agentPhoneNumbers: {
        select: { id: true },
        take: 1,
      },
    },
  });

  if (!organization) {
    throw new Error("Organization not found");
  }

  // Validate phone number exists
  if (!organization.agentPhoneNumbers[0]?.id) {
    throw new Error("No SMS phone number configured for organization");
  }

  // Find available mailbox
  const { findLeastUsedMailbox } = await import(
    "@/server/resource_access/mailbox-resource-accessor"
  );
  const since = new Date();
  since.setDate(since.getDate() - 7);
  const mailboxId = await findLeastUsedMailbox(organizationId, since);

  if (!mailboxId) {
    throw new Error("No email mailbox available for organization");
  }

  return { ...organization, mailboxId };
}

async function buildScheduleEventRequest(
  organization: {
    id: string;
    agentName: string | null;
    agentPhoneNumbers: { id: string }[];
    mailboxId: string;
  },
  input: z.infer<typeof scheduleEventSchema>,
  organizationId: string,
  opportunityId?: string,
) {
  const { mailboxId, agentPhoneNumbers } = organization;
  const smsContactMethodId = agentPhoneNumbers[0]?.id;

  if (!smsContactMethodId) {
    throw new Error("No SMS contact method available");
  }

  // Group participants by type
  const participantsByType = input.participants.reduce(
    (acc, p) => {
      if (!acc[p.type]) {
        acc[p.type] = [];
      }
      acc[p.type]!.push(p);
      return acc;
    },
    {} as Record<string, typeof input.participants>,
  );

  // Build precedence levels (candidates first, then users)
  const precedenceLevels = [];

  const candidates = participantsByType.candidate;
  if (candidates && candidates.length > 0) {
    precedenceLevels.push({
      role_description: "Candidate",
      participants: candidates.map((p) =>
        buildParticipantWithContact(
          p,
          mailboxId,
          smsContactMethodId,
          organizationId,
          input.timezone,
        ),
      ),
    });
  }

  const users = participantsByType.user;
  if (users && users.length > 0) {
    precedenceLevels.push({
      role_description: "User",
      participants: users.map((p) =>
        buildParticipantWithContact(
          p,
          mailboxId,
          smsContactMethodId,
          organizationId,
          input.timezone,
        ),
      ),
    });
  }

  // Transform known availabilities to API format with per-participant timezone
  const knownAvailabilities = input.knownAvailabilities
    ? Object.entries(input.knownAvailabilities).reduce(
        (acc, [participantId, participantAvailability]) => {
          if (participantAvailability.slots.length > 0) {
            // Use the participant's specific timezone for their availability
            acc[participantId] = participantAvailability.slots.map((slot) => {
              // Convert local datetime strings to ISO format with the participant's timezone
              const startDateTime = convertLocalDateTimeToTimezone(
                slot.startTime,
                participantAvailability.timezone,
              );
              const endDateTime = convertLocalDateTimeToTimezone(
                slot.endTime,
                participantAvailability.timezone,
              );

              return {
                start_time: startDateTime,
                end_time: endDateTime,
              };
            });
          }
          return acc;
        },
        {} as Record<string, { start_time: string; end_time: string }[]>,
      )
    : undefined;

  return {
    agent: {
      purplefish_id: organization.id,
      name: organization.agentName || "Purplefish AI",
    },
    meeting_name: input.meetingName,
    purpose: input.purpose,
    duration_minutes: input.duration,
    timeframe: input.timeframe,
    participant_precedence_levels: precedenceLevels,
    known_availabilities:
      knownAvailabilities && Object.keys(knownAvailabilities).length > 0
        ? knownAvailabilities
        : undefined,
    messaging_thread_id: uuidv4(),
    organization_id: organizationId,
    ...(opportunityId && { opportunity_id: opportunityId }),
  };
}

function buildParticipantWithContact(
  participant: z.infer<typeof participantSchema>,
  mailboxId: string,
  smsContactMethodId: string,
  organizationId: string,
  timezone: string,
) {
  const contactMethods = [];

  if (participant.email) {
    contactMethods.push({
      type: "Email" as const,
      value: participant.email,
      purplefish_contact_method_id: mailboxId,
    });
  }

  if (participant.phoneNumber) {
    contactMethods.push({
      type: "SMS" as const,
      value: participant.phoneNumber,
      purplefish_contact_method_id: smsContactMethodId,
    });
  }

  return {
    id: participant.id,
    first_name: participant.firstName,
    last_name: participant.lastName,
    purplefish_participant_id: participant.purplefishParticipantId,
    purplefish_organization_id: organizationId,
    contact_methods: contactMethods,
    timezone,
    contact_for_additional_availability:
      participant.contactForAdditionalAvailability,
  };
}
